text: やーん　＊ｃｍよ　こんなの　はじめてよー！

structure.jp: こんなの　はじめてよー！
structure.en: one like this is a first for me!

patterns.name: 〜の (one)
patterns.explanation: の here stands in for a thing already being talked about, like English 'one'. こんなの = 'one like this'.

patterns.name: 〜よ (feminine)
patterns.explanation: よ straight after a thing word, with no だ, is a womanly way of stating something. ＊ｃｍよ = 'it's ＊ cm!'
